phrases.label: advertise
phrases.fix: name what the component returns or accepts ("returns an empty tool list", "accepts this argument") instead of the speech verb

phrases.label: announce
phrases.fix: name what is returned, logged, or published instead of the speech verb

phrases.label: decide (non-reader subject)
phrases.fix: name the mechanism that produces the outcome ("the URL binds the profile", "precedence, highest first") instead of attributing a decision

phrases.label: choose (non-reader, non-model subject)
phrases.fix: name what selects the value and how, or use "selects" for a mechanical selection

phrases.label: refuse
phrases.fix: say "rejects" and name what is rejected

phrases.label: ignore
phrases.fix: say "discards" or "does not read", which state the mechanism rather than implying deliberate disregard

phrases.label: want (non-reader subject)
phrases.fix: name the requirement instead of a desire

phrases.label: cognition verb (non-model subject)
phrases.fix: name what the component stores, reads, or resolves instead of what it knows

phrases.label: see (non-model subject)
phrases.fix: name what is sent, returned, or displayed instead of what something sees

phrases.label: cares about
phrases.fix: name the field or condition the component actually reads
